description: Runs tests with coverage and returns structured coverage summary per file.

all.description: Include all source files in coverage, even untested ones (maps to --coverage.all for vitest, --all for nyc)

args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the coverage runner. Each element is validated to prevent flag injection.

branch.description: Collect branch coverage (maps to --cov-branch for pytest)

exclude.description: File patterns to exclude from coverage

failUnder.description: Minimum line coverage percentage; fail if below (maps to --cov-fail-under for pytest, --coverageThreshold for jest, --coverage.thresholds.lines for vitest, --check-coverage --lines for nyc)

filter.description: Test filter pattern to run coverage on a subset of tests

framework.description: Force a specific framework instead of auto-detecting

interpreter.description: Python interpreter path to use for pytest (overrides venv/PATH detection)

source.description: Source paths to scope coverage (maps to --cov=PATH for pytest, --collectCoverageFrom for jest, --coverage.include for vitest, --include for nyc)

name: coverage
title: Test Coverage
